Affiliation: DCC-FCUP & CRACS University of Porto, Porto, Portugal
arxiv-2108-06296.creator: Sandra Alves, Miguel Ramos
arxiv-2108-06296.description: Abstract In this work, we develop a polymorphic record calculus with extensible records. Extensible records are records that can have new fields added to them, or preexisting fields removed from them. We also develop a static type system for this calculus and a sound and complete type inference algorithm.

arxiv-2209-02351.title: Crossover between electron-electron and electron-phonon mediated pairing on the Kagome lattice
arxiv-2209-02351.creator: Xianxin Wu, Debmalya Chakraborty, Andreas P. Schnyder, Andrés Greco
arxiv-2209-02351.description: Abstract We study electron-electron and electron-phonon mediated pairing in the Holstein extended Hubbard model on the Kagome lattice near the van Hove fillings, and investigate their combined effects on electron pairing states. We find that their combination can promote exotic pairings in a crossover region, where the filling is close to a van Hove singularity.

arxiv-2304-03103.title: Retention Is All You Need Conference: Proceedings of the 32nd ACM International Conference on Information and Knowledge Management; October 21–25, 2023; Birmingham, United Kingdom Proceedings of the 32nd ACM International Conference on Information and Knowledge Management (CIKM ’23), October 21–25,
arxiv-2304-03103.creator: Karishma Mohiuddin, Mirza Ariful Alam, Mirza Mohtashim Alam, Pascal Welke, Michael Martin, Jens Lehmann, Sahar Vahdati
arxiv-2304-03103.description: Abstract . Skilled employees are the most important pillars of an organization. Despite this, most organizations face high attrition and turnover rates. While several machine learning models have been developed to analyze attrition and its causal factors, the interpretations of those models remain opaque.

arxiv-2306-12961.title: Quantum decay of scalar and vector boson stars and oscillons into gravitons
arxiv-2306-12961.creator: Kazunori Nakayama 1,2 , Fuminobu Takahashi 1 , Masaki Yamada 1,3 1 Department of Physics, Tohoku University, Sendai, Miyagi 980-8578, Japan 2 International Center for Quantum-field Measurement Systems for Studies of the Universe and Particles (QUP, WPI), KEK, 1-1 Oho, Tsukuba, Ibaraki 305-0801, Japa
arxiv-2306-12961.description: Abstract We point out that a soliton such as an oscillon or boson star inevitably decays into gravitons through gravitational interactions. These decay processes exist even if there are no apparent self-interactions of the constituent field, scalar or vector, since they are induced by gravitational interactions.

arxiv-2408-04927.creator: Shuhang Zhang, , Qingyu Liu, , Ke Chen, , Boya Di, , Hongliang Zhang, , Wenhan Yang, , Dusit Niyato, , Zhu Han, , and H. Vincent Poor
arxiv-2408-04927.description: Abstract The future sixth-generation (6G) of wireless networks is expected to surpass its predecessors by offering ubiquitous coverage through integrated air-ground facility deployments in both communication and computing domains. In this network, aerial facilities, such as unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), conduct artificial intelligence (AI) computations based on multi-modal data to support diverse applications including surveillance and environment construction.

arxiv-2410-13177.title: Chemical abundances of 20 barium stars from the OHP spectra
arxiv-2410-13177.creator: Guochao Yang, Jingkun Zhao, Yanchun Liang, Monique Spite, Francois Spite, Jianrong Shi, Shuai Liu, Nian Liu, Wenyuan Cui, Gang Zhao
arxiv-2410-13177.description: Abstract Based on the high resolution and high signal-to-noise spectra, we derived the chemical abundances of 20 elements for 20 barium (Ba-) stars. For the first time, the detailed abundances of four sample stars, namely HD 92482, HD 150430, HD 151101 and HD 177304 have been analyzed.

arxiv-2501-03979.title: Thermal Transport Properties of Magnons on the α \alpha -T 3 Lattice
arxiv-2501-03979.creator: Luqman Saleem, Hasan M. Abdullah, Udo Schwingenschlögl, Aurélien Manchon
arxiv-2501-03979.description: Abstract We theoretically investigate magnons on the α \alpha -T 3 lattice. Atomistic spin dynamics simulations show that next-nearest neighbor hopping and easy-axis anisotropy stabilize ferromagnetic order in the presence of Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction. We identify one topologically trivial magnon insulator phase and three magnon Chern insulator phases.

arxiv-2508-17041.creator: Connor Elliott, Courtney Hauf, Kai Morton, Sarah Petersen, Leticia Schow
arxiv-2508-17041.description: Abstract . We extend Wood’s graph theoretic interpretation of certain quotients of the mod 2 2 dual Steenrod algebra to quotients of the mod p p dual Steenrod algebra where p p is an odd prime and to quotients of the C 2 C_{2} -equivariant dual Steenrod algebra.

pmc-10694951.description: BackgroundThe HIV prevalence among Ethiopian female sex workers (FSWs) is estimated to be around 18.5%, which implies that FSWs' sexual partners are significantly exposed to HIV infection and that may be a major factor in HIV transmission in the community.

pmc-12495798.title: Patients’ experiences of thirst in the perioperative period: a phenomonological study
pmc-12495798.creator: Hatice Özsoy, Gönül Kara Söylemez
pmc-12495798.description: BackgroundThirst is a common symptom among surgical patients and an important symptom affecting patient comfort. Thirst in the perioperative period is often described by patients as a more uncomfortable experience than pain or hunger. This study was conducted to determine the thirst experiences of surgical patients in the perioperative period.

pmc-12967576.title: Genome assembly of the Neotropical marsh rat Holochilus nanus (Cricetidae: Sigmodontinae) brings insights on B and sex chromosome evolution
pmc-12967576.creator: Camila Nascimento Moreira, Jordana Oliveira, Yatiyo Yonenaga-Yassuda, Valter Aragão do Nascimento, Ivan Rodrigo Wolf, Cesar Martins
pmc-12967576.description: The Neotropical region comprises approximately 27% of mammal diversity, and rodents of the tribe Oryzomyini represent a significant portion of that. This diversity is reflected in the karyotype variability of the tribe, with a huge number of chromosomal rearrangements involving autosomal, sex, and B chromosomes.

pmc-13024131.title: Macrophage Extracellular Vesicles: Therapeutic Strategies for Corneal Fibrosis in Rare Diseases
pmc-13024131.creator: Haiming Li, Anne-Sophie Loewinger, Danial Roshandel, Yuan Fang, Jingjing You, Mark Daniell, Gink N. Yang
pmc-13024131.description: Corneal scarring (fibrosis) is a blinding condition affecting millions of sufferers worldwide. It is not only in common ocular injuries but also in genetically inherited rare diseases such as epidermolysis bullosa (EB), keratitis-ichthyosis-deafness (KID) syndrome and aniridia. In rare diseases like EB or KID syndrome, corneal fibrosis arises from chronic inflammation, structural instability and neuro-immune dysfunction driven by genetic mutations.

pmc-13484472.title: FcγR- and CD9-dependent synapse-engulfing microglia in the thalamus drive cognitive impairment following cortical brain damage in mice
pmc-13484472.creator: Ken Matoba, Takahiro Kochi, Oluwaseun Fatoba, Md Sorwer Alam Parvez, Inssaf Berkiks, Yassin R Mreyoud, Harrison Strong, Jana H Badrani, Hency Patel, Yoshiko Nagaoka-Kamata, Masakazu Kamata, Hiroshi Tsujioka, Toshihide Yamashita, David K Crossman, Minae Niwa, Shin-ichi Kano
pmc-13484472.description: Chronic neuroinflammation gives rise to diverse microglial states across the brain, yet how region-specific microglial remodeling contributes to cognitive dysfunction remains unclear. Here we report that synapse-engulfing microglia in the thalamus drive cognitive impairment after cortical brain damage in mice, primarily studied in females.

pmc-13654035.title: DNAJB12 mediates the causal effect of obesity on knee osteoarthritis: A mendelian randomization study
pmc-13654035.creator: An Wang, Hongying Shan, Xi Cao, Ye Li, Xuzhao Bian, Di Zhang, Xingjie Hao, Shiquan Sun
pmc-13654035.description: ObjectiveObesity is a major risk factor for knee osteoarthritis (KOA), but the circulating proteins that mediate this association remain unclear. We aimed to identify obesity-regulated circulating proteins that causally influence KOA risk.DesignWe conducted a Mendelian Randomization based proteome-wide association study (MR-PWAS) analysis to investigate circulating proteins mediating the effect of obesity on KOA.

pmc-13672686.title: Intratumoral Fusogenic Outer Membrane Vesicles Enhance Antitumor Immunity Through Tumor MHC‐I Upregulation and Tumor Bacterization
pmc-13672686.creator: Xing Liu, Jiaxin Zhou, Guihong Lu, Chenjing Zhao, Weixiu Wang, Jichuan Chen, Fengqi Zhang, Fan Zhang, Hai‐Yan Xie, Weidong Nie
pmc-13672686.description: Cold tumors evade APC and T‐cell surveillance through low immunogenicity, defective antigen presentation, and immunosuppressive tumor microenvironments. We uncovered a non‐canonical function of bacterial outer membrane vesicles (OMVs), whereby OMVs activated the TLR4–NF‐κB–NLRC5 axis to induce tumor MHC I upregulation, thereby restoring tumor visibility to T cells.
